title: Cloud Users and Groups
scenario: NewVue Health has completed tenant provisioning and must now prepare the cloud identity environment for administrative use. The system administrator needs to create cloud users, assign licenses, organize users into security groups, and verify that membership assignments support departmental access requirements. Because this is a complementary activity, use the case study and reference information below to complete the required tasks.

activities.title: Creating a Cloud User
activities.prompt: You want to create a new cloud user and complete the account setup correctly. Move the required actions into the Answer Area and arrange them in the correct order.
steps: Assign the required license and create the account
answer: Assign the required license and create the account
activities.explanation: Cloud user creation follows a defined workflow that begins with the user management interface and ends with account creation and licensing.

activities.title: License Assignment
activities.prompt: You want the new user to access Microsoft 365 services immediately after account creation. Select the action that best supports that objective.
options: Assign a license during account creation
Create a local profile on the workstation
activities.answer: Assign a license during account creation
activities.explanation: Without an assigned license, the user account exists but cannot consume Microsoft 365 services.

activities.title: Identity Administration Areas
activities.prompt: You want to continue identity administration in the tenant. Match each administrative area to the task it primarily supports.
activities.explanation: Different administrative areas are used for user creation, membership management, and license review.

activities.title: Selecting the Correct Group Type
activities.prompt: You want to group employees by department so permissions can be managed securely. Select the group type that best supports that objective.
activities.explanation: Security groups are designed for permission assignment and access control.

activities.title: Adding Users to a Group
activities.prompt: You want to place the correct users into a departmental security group. Move the required actions into the Answer Area and arrange them in the correct order.
activities.explanation: Group membership changes are applied through the group object, followed by member selection and save.

activities.title: Connecting Before Automation
activities.prompt: You want to automate user administration with PowerShell. Complete the command used to establish the Microsoft Graph connection before running user-management commands.
activities.explanation: Administrative automation begins by establishing the correct Microsoft Graph connection.
